assertions.claim: Sudden curtain-like blackout of one eye is retinal vessel occlusion; the longer it stays, the less retina can be saved.
assertions.cn_span: 一只眼突然像拉下窗帘一样黑掉，是眼底血管堵了

assertions.claim: It is one form of cerebral ischemia; the coming days are the peak window for stroke.
assertions.cn_span: 接下来几天正是中风高发窗口

assertions.claim: Same-day assessment/treatment cut 90-day recurrent stroke from 10.3% (32/310) to 2.1% (6/281) (Oxford EXPRESS).
assertions.cn_span: 90 天内再中风的比例从 10.3% 降到 2.1%

assertions.claim: Same day to an ED with a stroke center; don't wait for next-day ophthalmology (AHA 2021 CRAO statement: emergency).
assertions.cn_span: 当天去有卒中中心的急诊，不等第二天挂眼科

assertions.claim: Level B because EXPRESS is a sequential before/after comparison of the same population, not a randomized trial.
assertions.cn_span: EXPRESS 不是随机试验，是同一人群前后两期的序贯比较
